blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 PMKSY Completes 10 Years of Sustainable Irrigation; Cabinet Approves M-CADWM Sub-Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Allocates ₹6,587 crore in Budget 2026-27 for micro-irrigation under Per Drop More Crop.
PMKSY Overview: Launched July 1, 2015; continued for 2021-26 with ₹93,068.56 crore outlay (benefited 27M+ farmers).
Per Drop More Crop (PDMC): 110.92 lakh hectares brought under micro-irrigation.
M-CADWM Sub-Scheme: Cabinet approved Modernization of Command Area Development & Water Management with ₹1,600 crore initial outlay for pipeline networks.
PMKSY total continuation outlay (₹93,068.56 crore) vs M-CADWM initial sub-scheme outlay (₹1,600 crore).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on CAD as % of GDP (1.3%), merchandise trade deficit figures, and invisibles/remittances surplus trajectory.
